subject: [PATCH v3 3/5] fs/proc/task_mmu: read the PMD once in smaps_pmd_entry()

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Identified a minor issue with const correctness in smaps_pmd_entry() and suggested making the pmdp_get() result const.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Agreed with the patch's optimization approach and suggested no changes.
reviews.raw_body:
On 23 Nov 2026, at 11:32, Usama Arif wrote:

> smaps_pmd_entry() dereferences the pmd pointer six times. Read it once
> into a local with pmdp_get(), the way smaps_pte_entry() already does
> with ptep_get(), so that every test sees the same value.
>
> No functional change intended.
>
> Suggested-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>
> Signed-off-by: Usama Arif <usama.arif@linux.dev>
> ---
>  fs/proc/task_mmu.c | 11 ++++++-----
>  1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
>
Makes sense.

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

reviews.author: Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Responded positively to the reviews and asked if he should wait a few days before resending the series with the const change.
reviews.raw_body:
On 23/11/2026 09:24, Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) wrote:
> On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 08:32:09AM -0800, Usama Arif wrote:
>> smaps_pmd_entry() dereferences the pmd pointer six times. Read it once
>> into a local with pmdp_get(), the way smaps_pte_entry() already does
>> with ptep_get(), so that every test sees the same value.
>>
>> No functional change intended.
>>
>> Suggested-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>
>> Signed-off-by: Usama Arif <usama.arif@linux.dev>
> 
> LGTM so:
> 
> Reviewed-by: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) <ljs@kernel.org>


Thanks for the reviews!!

> 
>> ---
>>  fs/proc/task_mmu.c | 11 ++++++-----
>>  1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
>>
>> diff --git a/fs/proc/task_mmu.c b/fs/proc/task_mmu.c
>> index 540c936aad4714..105c4998eef48f 100644
>> --- a/fs/proc/task_mmu.c
>> +++ b/fs/proc/task_mmu.c
>> @@ -1022,14 +1022,15 @@ static void smaps_pmd_entry(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr,
>>  	struct page *page = NULL;
>>  	bool present = false;
>>  	struct folio *folio;
>> +	pmd_t pmdval = pmdp_get(pmd);
> 
> NIT: Can this be const or are the helpers not safe for it?

Ah yes, good point. Its good to have const here.

I think the rest of the series is good to merge. Should I wait
a few days and send a new revision with the const change here?

> 
>>
>> -	if (pmd_none(*pmd))
>> +	if (pmd_none(pmdval))
>>  		return;
>> -	if (pmd_present(*pmd)) {
>> -		page = vm_normal_page_pmd(vma, addr, *pmd);
>> +	if (pmd_present(pmdval)) {
>> +		page = vm_normal_page_pmd(vma, addr, pmdval);
>>  		present = true;
>>  	} else if (unlikely(thp_migration_supported())) {
>> -		const softleaf_t entry = softleaf_from_pmd(*pmd);
>> +		const softleaf_t entry = softleaf_from_pmd(pmdval);
>>
>>  		if (softleaf_has_pfn(entry))
>>  			page = softleaf_to_page(entry);
>> @@ -1046,7 +1047,7 @@ static void smaps_pmd_entry(pmd_t *pmd, unsigned long addr,
>>  	else
>>  		mss->file_thp += HPAGE_PMD_SIZE;
>>
>> -	smaps_account(mss, page, true, pmd_young(*pmd), pmd_dirty(*pmd),
>> +	smaps_account(mss, page, true, pmd_young(pmdval), pmd_dirty(pmdval),
>>  		      locked, present);
>>  }
>>  #else
>> --
>> 2.53.1-Meta
>>
> 
> --
> Cheers, Lorenzo

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Recommended picking the first two patches directly and suggested resending the remaining three for Andrew to review.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the smaps_pmd_entry() function in fs/proc/task_mmu.c by reading the PMD pointer only once and storing it in a local variable, reducing unnecessary dereferences.
